summary: Black Spade Acquisition III Co, a Cayman Islands NYSE-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to its August 27, 2026 business combination agreement with Astrum Space Inc and its Singapore subsidiary Astrum Networks Pte. Ltd., under which Astrum merges into Black Spade III and Astrum Singapore becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of the surviving company. The amendment only revises the post-closing listing venue, permitting NYSE (including NYSE American) or Nasdaq (including Capital, Global, Global Select) as mutually agreed in writing. No economic terms changed. Watch for venue selection, redemptions and closing timing.
